title: Rambut Keriting
overview: To avoid an arranged marriage chosen by her parents, Lia decides to run away with the man she loves, even though Rully is an unemployed man who is merely taking advantage of her parents' wealth. Fortunately, Lia meets Andy, a journalist who is suspicious of Rully's behavior. It is later revealed that Rully is, in fact, the very man Lia's parents had intended for her to marry.
